children: Core AI Holdings received a Nasdaq notice that its June 30, 2026 unaudited shareholders’ equity was $2.43M, below the $2.5M minimum. The company has until Nov. 2, 2026 to submit a compliance plan, with up to 180 days from the notice date to regain compliance.
Noncompliance risks delisting; signals balance sheet strain and potential financing or asset actions.
Short timeline; plan acceptance could extend cure period and ease near-term delisting risk.
Buys time to raise equity or improve balance sheet; delays binary delisting risk.
Loss of Nasdaq listing would hurt liquidity and could pressure valuation.

This is an early regulatory warning highlighting thin equity and listing risk. A credible, funded plan to boost shareholders’ equity above $2.5M—or actual equity raise/retained earnings—would turn this into a positive catalyst.
Based on the original press release from Core AI Holdings, Inc. distributed by GlobeNewswire.
